attributes.name: nosync
attributes.rule: `presence`. A ground or object is synchronised only when neither it nor the settings carry `nosync`.
attributes.meaning: Turns off room synchronisation for every ground and object of the map.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.rule: `truthy`, lower-cased. Only `halloween` has an effect (it changes the cheese picture, see decorations).
attributes.meaning: Event theme.

attributes.name: mc
attributes.meaning: Hides the pictures of the nails placed in the map: no nail picture is added during the first 5 seconds of a round. The nails still hold.

attributes.name: dodue
attributes.meaning: Lets mice collect several cheeses; the cheese is drawn as a cheese pile.

attributes.name: aie
attributes.note: What the game does with the flag has not been checked; the meaning is the community documentation's.
attributes.meaning: Makes mice shock-sensitive: falls from a height, strong bounces and being squeezed kill them.

attributes.name: bh
attributes.meaning: Lets cannonballs fly upwards (placed in the map or summoned by the shaman). Without it a cannonball's upward speed is set to 0.

attributes.name: mgoc
attributes.rule: `int`, whenever the attribute is present (an empty value gives 0).
attributes.meaning: Mass given to every shaman object except type 32, summoned or placed in the map.

attributes.name: Ca
attributes.meaning: Hides everything outside the 800x600 game area behind a frame in the room colour.

attributes.name: G
attributes.rule: `presence`. Split on `,`: wind = `number` of field 1, gravity = `number` of field 2. A wind that is `NaN` becomes 0, a gravity that is `NaN` becomes 10. The wind is negated in a mirrored room.
attributes.meaning: Wind (positive blows to the right) and gravity (default 10; negative turns it upside down).

attributes.name: N
attributes.note: Whether the first number is a radius or a diameter, and what the second number selects, have not been checked in the game.
attributes.rule: `presence` turns night mode on. A non-empty value is split on `,`: one field sets the size, two fields the size and the type (both `number`); any other number of fields sets neither.
attributes.meaning: Night mode: mice only see a small circle around them. First number: the size of the circle; second: who is in the dark (0 everyone, 1 the shaman, 2 the mice). Default `150,0`.

attributes.name: C
attributes.note: The effect has not been checked in the game; the meaning is the community documentation's.
attributes.meaning: Collision mode: mice collide with each other.

attributes.name: A
attributes.meaning: Soulmate mode: mice are tied in pairs. The game draws a heart near the top left corner.

attributes.name: F
attributes.meaning: Map background: the picture `$F_<id>`, drawn behind everything and stretched to the map size. `-1`: none; `-2`: the game picks one at random.

attributes.name: P
attributes.note: The effect has not been checked in the game; the meaning is the community documentation's.
attributes.meaning: Lets the shaman summon portals.

attributes.name: shaman_tools
attributes.rule: `truthy`. Split on `,`, each field `int`; zeros are dropped, and an empty result counts as no list.
attributes.meaning: Replaces the objects the shaman can summon with these ids. The arrow (0) cannot be added, skills do not work, and a skinned object only shows for players who own the skin.

attributes.name: defilante
attributes.rule: `presence` turns defilante mode on. Split on `,`: start speed = `int` of field 1 (at least 0) / 36, acceleration = `number0` of field 2 / 360, maximum speed = `number0` of field 3 / 36, free scroll = field 4 is `one`.
attributes.meaning: Defilante (scrolling race) mode. In this mode the objects 6, 32, 15 and 16 become markers instead of objects, and the width limit of a restricted map is 4800.

attributes.name: L
attributes.rule: `truthy`, then `int`. An empty value keeps the default.
attributes.meaning: Map width in pixels. The documented maximum is 1600 (4800 with `defilante`); the game enforces it only for restricted maps, and saved maps are often wider.

attributes.name: H
attributes.rule: `truthy`, then `int`. An empty value keeps the default.
attributes.meaning: Map height in pixels. The documented maximum is 800; the game enforces it only for restricted maps.

attributes.name: DS
attributes.rule: `truthy`. The value is `kind;payload` with exactly one `;`, otherwise it is ignored. `m;x1,y1,x2,y2,...`: up to 20 points (at most 40 numbers are read, an odd last number is dropped); `x;N`: X fixed at N, random Y; `y;N`: Y fixed at N, random X; `r;x,y,w,h`: a rectangle. All numbers `int`; other kinds are ignored.
attributes.meaning: Mouse spawn points.

attributes.name: D
attributes.rule: `truthy`. `#url,w,h`: one tiled bitmap; a value without a comma: one image at (0, 0); otherwise `;`-separated groups of `url,x,y,repeat,dx` tuples.
attributes.meaning: Background images, drawn behind the grounds.

attributes.name: d
attributes.rule: `truthy`. A value without a comma: one image at (0, 0); otherwise `;`-separated groups, each a run of 4-field tuples `url,x,y,repeat`. The repeat offset is the fifth field of the last `D` tuple (a bug of the game).
attributes.meaning: Foreground images, drawn over the grounds, the objects and the mice.

attributes.name: APS
attributes.rule: `truthy`. `;`-separated groups; only a group of exactly 8 fields `url,mode,x,y,w,h,imageX,imageY` makes an image.
attributes.meaning: Disappearing images: drawn whole at (imageX, imageY) in the top layer, they fade out while the player is inside the rectangle (x, y, w, h). Off in restricted maps.

attributes.name: ARPS
attributes.meaning: Appearing images: not shown at load; an image fades in, in the bottom layer, while the player is inside its rectangle, and fades out when they leave. Only in maps opened as official maps.

attributes.name: IP
attributes.rule: `truthy`. `;`-separated groups; only a group of exactly 3 fields `url,x,y` makes an image.
attributes.meaning: Images a server message shows for 5 seconds on a few event maps; not shown at load. Off in restricted maps.

attributes.name: T
attributes.meaning: Ground type, 0 to 21 (see ground types). Other values are drawn like wood and get the default physics.

attributes.name: X
attributes.meaning: Horizontal position in pixels; the ground is centred on (X, Y).

attributes.name: Y
attributes.meaning: Vertical position in pixels.

attributes.name: L
attributes.rule: `int`, then kept between 10 and 4000 (`derived.width`; `width` is the written value).
attributes.meaning: Width in pixels; for a circle (13) the radius.

attributes.name: H
attributes.meaning: Height in pixels; a circle ignores it.

attributes.name: name
attributes.meaning: Name the ground is registered under; a galaxy ground (21) is found by this name through `target`.

attributes.name: target
attributes.note: The game stores the value; what uses it has not been seen.
attributes.meaning: Name of the ground a galaxy ground leads to.

attributes.name: nosync
attributes.meaning: Disables synchronisation of a dynamic ground with the room.

attributes.name: c
attributes.note: The collision masks are verified; which mask stands for mice and which for shaman objects is inferred.
attributes.rule: `int`; water (9) and cobweb (15) always use 5. Groups 0 and 1 collide with mice and objects (a cloud, 8, with group 0: objects only), 2 with objects only, 3 with mice only, anything else with nothing.
attributes.meaning: Collision group: what the ground stops. The community documentation numbers the groups differently (1 all, 2 objects and grounds, 3 mice and objects, 4 nothing).

attributes.name: v
attributes.meaning: Time in milliseconds after which the ground disappears.

attributes.name: m
attributes.meaning: Hides the ground's picture; its physics stays.

attributes.name: inputSpeedBonus
attributes.note: What the game does with it has not been seen.
attributes.rule: `float`, whenever the attribute is present; `NaN` becomes 0.
attributes.meaning: Speed bonus of a galaxy ground.

attributes.name: outputSpeedBonus
attributes.note: What the game does with it has not been seen.
attributes.rule: `float`, whenever the attribute is present; `NaN` becomes 0.
attributes.meaning: Speed bonus of a galaxy ground.

attributes.name: invertOutputPoint
attributes.note: The game stores the flag; what uses it has not been seen.
attributes.meaning: Flag of a galaxy ground.

attributes.name: addInputGroundSpeed
attributes.note: The game stores the flag; what uses it has not been seen.
attributes.meaning: Flag of a galaxy ground.

attributes.name: tint
attributes.rule: `hex`, whenever the attribute is present; `NaN` becomes 0 and the value is kept as a 32-bit integer.
attributes.meaning: Colour transform of the ground's picture: each channel is multiplied by the tint's channel / 128, so `808080` changes nothing.

attributes.name: grav
attributes.note: Follows from how the game builds a ground; not checked in the game.
attributes.meaning: Multiplies the gravity applied to the ground's own body. Only a dynamic ground has a body, so it does nothing on a static ground; it does not change gravity for mice.

attributes.name: col
attributes.note: What the physics does with the flag has not been seen.
attributes.meaning: Touch-collision flag on the ground's shapes.

attributes.name: lua
attributes.rule: `number`, whenever the attribute is present (`NaN` stays `NaN`).
attributes.meaning: Id that identifies the ground in Lua.

attributes.name: contact
attributes.note: What the physics does with it has not been seen.
attributes.meaning: Contact number copied to the ground's shapes.

attributes.name: friction
attributes.note: The sticky and slippery reading is a third-party editor's; the game's honey code has not been seen.
attributes.rule: `truthy`. Split on `,`: two `number` fields (`NaN` when missing). When the first is not 0 the ground is honey with these two numbers.
attributes.meaning: Not the friction coefficient (that is field 3 of `P`): makes the ground honey. Sticky when the first number is 0 or more (strength 5 x first), slippery otherwise (strength -first); duration first / second.

attributes.name: i
attributes.rule: Whenever the attribute is present: split on `,`, at least 3 fields: x = `int` of field 1, y = `int` of field 2, URL = field 3 (a URL containing a comma is cut).
attributes.meaning: Image that replaces the ground's picture, placed at (x, y) from the ground's top left corner. Off in restricted maps.

attributes.name: P
attributes.note: That fields 3 and 4 are friction and restitution is inferred from three agreeing sources; the physics code that reads them has not been seen.
attributes.rule: `truthy`; ignored for water (9). Split on `,`: field 1 is `one` (dynamic), 2 mass, 3 friction, 4 restitution, 5 angle in degrees, 6 is `one` (fixed rotation), 7 linear damping, 8 angular damping. The numbers are `number`, `NaN` when missing.
attributes.meaning: Physics: dynamic, mass, friction, restitution, angle, fixed rotation, linear and angular damping. Mass, fixed rotation and the dampings only act on dynamic grounds; a negative mass makes a dynamic ground immovable.

attributes.name: o
attributes.meaning: Colour of a rectangle (12) or circle (13) ground; other types ignore it. Without it those two are white.

attributes.name: N
attributes.meaning: Draws the ground in front of the mice. Water, cobweb and galaxy (9, 15, 21) are always in front.

attributes.name: archAcc
attributes.note: The unit and the effect in the game are unknown.
attributes.rule: Water (`T=9`) and cobweb (`T=15`) only: `truthy`, then `number`. Other types ignore it.
attributes.meaning: Area physics value of water or cobweb.

attributes.name: archMax
attributes.note: The unit and the effect in the game are unknown.
attributes.rule: Water (`T=9`) and cobweb (`T=15`) only: `truthy`, then `number`. Other types ignore it.
attributes.meaning: Area physics value of water or cobweb.

attributes.name: archCheeseMax
attributes.note: The unit and the effect in the game are unknown.
attributes.rule: Water (`T=9`) and cobweb (`T=15`) only: `truthy`, then `number`. Other types ignore it.
attributes.meaning: Area physics value of water or cobweb.

attributes.name: linDampAcc
attributes.note: The unit and the effect in the game are unknown.
attributes.rule: Water (`T=9`) and cobweb (`T=15`) only: `truthy`, then `number`. Other types ignore it.
attributes.meaning: Area linear-damping value of water or cobweb.

attributes.name: linDampMax
attributes.note: The unit and the effect in the game are unknown.
attributes.rule: Water (`T=9`) and cobweb (`T=15`) only: `truthy`, then `number`. Other types ignore it.
attributes.meaning: Area linear-damping value of water or cobweb.

attributes.name: angDampAcc
attributes.note: The unit and the effect in the game are unknown.
attributes.rule: Water (`T=9`) and cobweb (`T=15`) only: `truthy`, then `number`. Other types ignore it.
attributes.meaning: Area angular-damping value of water or cobweb.

attributes.name: angDampMax
attributes.note: The unit and the effect in the game are unknown.
attributes.rule: Water (`T=9`) and cobweb (`T=15`) only: `truthy`, then `number`. Other types ignore it.
attributes.meaning: Area angular-damping value of water or cobweb.

attributes.name: X
attributes.meaning: Horizontal position.

attributes.name: Y
attributes.meaning: Vertical position.

attributes.name: D
attributes.meaning: Draws a hole over the grounds, or a cheese over the mice.

attributes.name: CT
attributes.rule: `int`: 1 and 2 are colours, anything else is none.
attributes.meaning: Hole colour: 1 gives the hole a cyan glow, 2 a pink one. Which mice may enter is decided by the server.

attributes.name: T
attributes.meaning: Decoration id: the picture `$P_<T>`.

attributes.name: P
attributes.note: The random flip follows the game's code; being random, it cannot be compared with the game.
attributes.rule: Required: a `P` decoration without it makes the map fail to load. Split on `,`: field 1 is `one` (foreground); field 2 `int`: 1 always flipped, 2 flipped at random (one time in two), anything else not flipped. In a mirrored room the code becomes 0 when it is above 0, otherwise 1.
attributes.meaning: Foreground flag and horizontal flip.

attributes.name: C
attributes.meaning: Hex colours of the decoration's colourable parts, in order. A part with no colour in the list is black; without the attribute the parts keep their library colour.

attributes.name: size
attributes.rule: Not read by the game. The module, on the first `DS`: Lua `tonumber`; otherwise 1.
attributes.meaning: parkour: the mouse's size at the start.

attributes.name: cheese
attributes.rule: Not read by the game. The module, on the first `DS`: `0` removes the cheese, any other value gives it.
attributes.meaning: parkour: the mouse starts with the cheese.

attributes.name: C
attributes.rule: `int`; the element's own name is not read. Above 99 the number packs a base type and a skin (see objects).
attributes.meaning: Object type.

attributes.name: X
attributes.meaning: Horizontal position.

attributes.name: Y
attributes.meaning: Vertical position.

attributes.name: nosync
attributes.meaning: Disables room synchronisation of the object.

attributes.name: Mv
attributes.rule: `truthy`, then `number`. Negated in a mirrored room.
attributes.meaning: Rotation speed of a nail (11 to 16; positive turns anticlockwise).

attributes.name: Mp
attributes.meaning: Rotation power of a nail (11 to 16).

attributes.name: P
attributes.rule: `truthy`. Split on `,`: field 1 `int` is the angle in degrees, clockwise (negated in a mirrored room); with a second field, `1` makes the object a ghost.
attributes.meaning: Angle and ghost flag. A ghost does not collide with mice and is drawn translucent.

attributes.name: stop
attributes.rule: Not read by the game. The module: written at all (`presence`, any value), on a yellow nail (`C="22"`).
attributes.meaning: parkour: reaching this checkpoint stops the mouse (it is respawned there, without speed).

attributes.name: size
attributes.rule: Not read by the game. The module: Lua `tonumber` (decimal or `0x` hex); not a number or absent: the size of the previous checkpoint (the spawn's is 1).
attributes.meaning: parkour: the mouse's size from this checkpoint on.

attributes.name: cheese
attributes.rule: Not read by the game. The module: `0` (as a Lua number, so also `0.0`) removes the cheese, any other value, even an empty one, gives it.
attributes.meaning: parkour: the mouse gets (`give`) or loses (`remove`) the cheese at this checkpoint.

attributes.name: M1
attributes.meaning: First joined ground: its index in the map's ground list.

attributes.name: M2
attributes.meaning: Second joined ground.

attributes.name: P1
attributes.meaning: First anchor point (x,y).

attributes.name: P2
attributes.meaning: Second anchor point (x,y).

attributes.name: HZ
attributes.note: Sources disagree on the name: a third-party editor calls it frequency, the community documentation damping or tautness.
attributes.meaning: Spring frequency of a distance joint.

attributes.name: AMP
attributes.note: Sources disagree on the name: a third-party editor calls it damping, the community documentation elasticity.
attributes.meaning: Damping of a distance joint.

attributes.name: AXIS
attributes.rule: Split on `,`, two `int` fields; x is negated in a mirrored room.
attributes.meaning: Axis of a prismatic joint.

attributes.name: A
attributes.meaning: Angle of a prismatic joint.

attributes.name: LIM1
attributes.meaning: First limit.

attributes.name: LIM2
attributes.meaning: Second limit.

attributes.name: MV
attributes.rule: `truthy`. Split on `,`: two `number` fields, power and speed; a `JR` negates the speed in a mirrored room.
attributes.meaning: Motor power and speed.

attributes.name: P3
attributes.meaning: First ground anchor of a pulley.

attributes.name: P4
attributes.meaning: Second ground anchor of a pulley.

attributes.name: R
attributes.meaning: Pulley ratio.

attributes.name: c
attributes.note: That a child which is not a joint styles the previous joint follows the game's code; it has not been checked in the game.
attributes.rule: `truthy`. Split on `,`: colour `hexcolor`, thickness `int` (default 1), alpha `number0` (default 1), foreground is `one` (default no). Each field is read only when the value has that many. On a child of `L` that is not a joint it applies to the previous joint.
attributes.meaning: Look of the joint line: colour, thickness, alpha 0 to 1, foreground flag. A joint without it is invisible.

attributes.name: lua
attributes.note: That a child which is not a joint changes the previous joint follows the game's code; it has not been checked in the game.
attributes.rule: `int`, whenever the attribute is present. On a child of `L` that is not a joint it applies to the previous joint; before any joint it makes the map fail to load.
attributes.meaning: Lua id of the joint.

attributes.name: id
attributes.rule: Empty or absent: the particle is not created (`img` alone is not enough). `#rrggbb`: the colourable particle picture in that colour (`hex`); otherwise `int`, an index into the game's particle list.
attributes.meaning: The picture of the particles.

attributes.name: img
attributes.rule: Used only on official maps (the flag that also enables `ARPS`; a `#Module` author is not enough), and only when `id` is not empty; there it replaces the picture of `id`. An image URL (see images), centred on the particle. The emitter waits until the image has loaded.
attributes.meaning: An image as the picture of the particles.

attributes.name: dur
attributes.meaning: How long each particle lives, in milliseconds (not how long the emitter runs).

attributes.name: int
attributes.meaning: Time between two emissions, in milliseconds; one particle per emission. 0 emits every frame.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.note: The code that uses the flag is not known; the emitter itself never stops either way.
attributes.meaning: Passed to every particle the emitter creates; most likely the particle's picture repeats its animation.

attributes.name: ori
attributes.rule: `truthy`. Split on `,`: two `int` fields, x and y.
attributes.meaning: Where the particles start (the emitter's position).

attributes.name: sp
attributes.note: The load failure follows the game's code; no map with particles has been checked in the game.
attributes.rule: `truthy`. `xFrom,xTo;yFrom,yTo`, each `number`; a group with one number uses it for both. The game decides whether the y group exists from the length of the whole value, not from the number of groups: a value of two characters or more without `;` makes the map fail to load.
attributes.meaning: Speed of each particle when it is emitted: a random value between `from` and `to` on each axis, in pixels per frame.

attributes.name: acc
attributes.note: The load failure follows the game's code; no map with particles has been checked in the game.
attributes.meaning: Acceleration of each particle: a random value between `from` and `to` on each axis, added to its speed every frame.

coercions.name: int
coercions.effect: Whole number. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored, `0x` hex and exponents are read, the fraction is cut off (towards zero) and the result wraps around at 32 bits. Anything that is not a number, an empty value and an absent attribute give 0.

coercions.name: number
coercions.effect: Decimal number. Spaces around it are ignored, `0x` hex, exponents and `Infinity` are read. An empty value is 0; an absent attribute or text that is not a number is `NaN` (the rule says what replaces it). `0b`, `0o` and `_` separators are not numbers.

coercions.name: float
coercions.effect: The number at the start of the value, ignoring what follows it (`2.5x` is 2.5); `NaN` when the value does not start with a number.

coercions.name: hex
coercions.effect: Hexadecimal number: leading spaces and a `0x` prefix are skipped, reading stops at the first character that is not a hex digit, and `NaN` when there is none (the rule says what replaces it).

coercions.name: hexcolor
coercions.effect: `int` of `0x` followed by the value: a hex colour written without `#`. Anything that is not hex gives 0 (black).

coercions.name: presence
coercions.effect: True when the attribute is written at all, even empty (`nosync=""`); the value is not read.

coercions.name: truthy
coercions.effect: The attribute is used only when its value is not empty. `"0"` counts as a value.

coercions.name: one
coercions.effect: True only when the value is exactly `1`.

groundTypes.name: cloud
groundTypes.note: Collision group 0 collides with shaman objects only.

groundTypes.name: water
groundTypes.note: An area: collision group always 5, `P` is ignored, area physics attributes apply.

groundTypes.name: circle
groundTypes.note: Plain colour `o` (white without it); `L` is the radius, `H` is ignored.

groundTypes.name: cobweb
groundTypes.note: An area: collision group always 5, area physics attributes apply.

groundTypes.name: wood2
groundTypes.note: Drawn with the plain plank picture.

groundTypes.name: acid
groundTypes.note: The body is marked as acid.

groundTypes.name: galaxy
groundTypes.note: A cup-shaped frame rather than a solid block; the top strip is drawn behind the mice.

collisionPresets.usedFor: ground `c` 3; the walls around the map

restricted.restricted: the first 40, and none after child index 200

diagnostics.meaning: The parser (lenient by default; `lenient: false` is strict) recovered from markup a strict XML parser rejects, the way the game accepts it. `kind` is `stray-quotes` (`''` where an attribute name should start), `doubled-lt` (`<<`) or `garbled-tag-name` (a tag name containing `=`, quotes, `<` or `?`, read up to the next space, `/` or `>`).
diagnostics.game: Real maps with these three faults run in the game; other malformed markup has not been tested.

diagnostics.meaning: An element repeats an attribute name. The last value wins.
diagnostics.game: Verified: the last value is used.

diagnostics.meaning: `&#...;` with an out-of-range or malformed number; kept as text.
diagnostics.game: Cannot occur in an editor-made map (`&` is not allowed).

diagnostics.meaning: `&name;` other than amp, lt, gt, quot, apos; kept as text.
diagnostics.game: Cannot occur in an editor-made map (`&` is not allowed).

diagnostics.meaning: More than one top-level element; the first is the root.
diagnostics.game: The first node is the map.

diagnostics.meaning: The text contains characters the editor does not allow; `characters` lists them. `$` only occurs in old maps and admin tools.
diagnostics.game: None: the game reads any text; only the editor refuses to save it.

diagnostics.meaning: The settings carry `PNJ`, an attribute from 2012 that placed characters from the map. It no longer has an effect.
Text between tags (only a space is possible) takes a position, so the zone is not the second child of the root or has fewer than three children.
diagnostics.game: The map fails to load. Spaces after the last container that matters are harmless.

diagnostics.meaning: Text (usually formatting whitespace) sits among the first two children of the root.
diagnostics.game: The game counts text as a child, so it would read the settings or the zone from the wrong element. `structureMode: "client-raw"` reproduces this.

diagnostics.meaning: Text sits among the first four children of the zone.
diagnostics.game: The same shift for the ground, decoration, object and joint containers.
Each text node becomes an empty ground, decoration or object.

diagnostics.meaning: A child of `L` is not `JD`, `JP`, `JPL` or `JR` but carries `c` and/or `lua`.
diagnostics.game: The style or Lua id is applied to the previous joint; `joint.staleCarry.targetIndex` names it.

diagnostics.meaning: A child of `L` that is not a joint carries `lua` before any joint.
The root has no second element.
diagnostics.game: The map fails to load (it is not an empty map).

diagnostics.meaning: The zone has fewer than three element children (the ground, decoration or object container is missing).
A particle `sp` or `acc` of two characters or more has no second `;` group.
`d` repeats an image but `D` has no `url,x,y,...` tuple (it is absent, `#...`, or a single URL).
diagnostics.game: The map fails to load: the repeat offset comes from a `D` tuple that does not exist.

drawOrder.contents: the room colour, the map background `F`, the background images `D` (first), then in map order every decoration, hole and cheese that is not in the foreground; `ARPS` images when they appear
only used by the game's built-in maps; empty for XML maps
joint lines that are not in the foreground, every ground (with the galaxy strip behind its ground), then the foreground holes (`D` on `T`)
the mice and the arrow (object 0); the renderer draws no mice
shaman objects, the foreground cheese (`D` on `F`)
foreground joint lines, foreground `d` images (first), foreground grounds (`N`; types 9, 15, 21), foreground decorations, `APS` images, the soulmate heart
the `Ca` frame, over everything and never mirrored
